description_en: Invokes the GrantInstanceToVbr operation to grant authorization of a VPC-connected instance to a VBR instance for cross-account VBR uplink scenarios
description_zh: 调用GrantInstanceToVbr接口将跨账号创建VBR上连场景的VPC实例授权给VBR实例
kebab_example: aliyun vpc grant-instance-to-vbr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-owner-uid 1210123456123456 --vbr-instance-ids vbr-m5ex0xf63xk8s5bob0000,vbr-bp1h6efd7a5g66xxd0000 --instance-id vpc-bp1lqhq93q8evjpky0000 --grant-type All --vbr-region-no cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantInstanceToVbr

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC-connected instance for which to grant authorization.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要授权的VPC实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID that owns the VBR instance to be granted authorization
parameters.help_zh: 接受授权的VBR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: vbr_owner_uid

parameters.help_en: The list of VBR instances to be granted authorization
parameters.help_zh: 接受授权的VBR实例的列表信息
parameters.name: vbr_instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC-connected instance for which to grant authorization
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of VBR instances to be granted authorization. Valid values:

- **All**: Grants authorization of the VPC-connected instance to all VBR instances in the specified region under the specified Alibaba Cloud account. In this case, the **VbrInstanceIds** parameter can be left empty.
- **Specify**: Grants authorization of the VPC-connected instance to the specified VBR instances. In this case, the **VbrInstanceIds** parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
接受授权的VBR实例的范围。取值：

- **All**：将VPC实例授权给指定地域和阿里云账号（主账号）下所有的VBR实例，此时**VbrInstanceIds**参数可以为空。
- **Specify**：将VPC实例授权给指定VBR实例，此时**VbrInstanceIds**参数需要配置
parameters.name: grant_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VBR instance to be granted authorization
parameters.help_zh: 接受授权的VBR实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: vbr_region_no
